market_question: Will Dan Cox win the 2026 Maryland Governor Republican primary election?
reasoning: Dan Cox won the 2022 primary largely due to Trump's endorsement, but lost the general election by a large margin, harming his electability narrative. Without a new compelling reason to support him again, GOP primary voters may opt for a moderate with better general-election prospects. The current 57.5% implied probability appears too high given his weak track record.
evidence_points: Cox lost the 2022 general election 35% to 64%, demonstrating poor appeal to a broader electorate.
Maryland GOP primary voters have historically preferred moderates (e.g., Larry Hogan) except when Trump intervened heavily.
There is no current sign of a Cox campaign or major endorsements, while other candidates may emerge.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of 2022 Maryland governor race results
Recall of Trump endorsement dynamics in primaries
